===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Atheros]] AR7161 @680MHz ([[MIPS 24K]]) *Storage: 64MB (NAND), 64KB (SPI) Flash *Memory: 128MB (DDR) SDRAM *Network: 9x Fast Ethernet ports *PCI: 3x Mini PCI slots *Power: 8-28V via barrel or passive PoE
